name: Agent-Capture Revival (MCP write-only)
objective: Reintroduce the retired agent-decided feedback capture as a write-only MCP surface: agents linked to a project's Vocky MCP endpoint save user feedback at their own judgement via a single capture_feedback tool, feeding the same feedback queue/store as REST. Scoped by P2 per-project credentials and aligned with P3's v2 capture shape; the three retired read tools stay retired.
